name: Ahmet Mert Dinçer

sections.title: Professional Summary
sections.body: Systems engineer at SDT with hands-on responsibility for an OKD/KubeVirt production cluster, end-to-end DevOps tooling (GitLab CI/CD, Nexus, SonarQube, ArgoCD, TeamCity, YouTrack), and a full observability stack (Prometheus federation, Grafana, Loki, Alloy, OpenTelemetry Collector). Background as a SOC analyst across IBM QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel, CrowdStrike Falcon, and Vectra EDR. Active full-stack developer (Next.js + Supabase) shipping side projects and freelance work. Comfortable from Linux/CoreOS internals up to TypeScript and from packet captures to React Server Components.

items.title: Systems Engineer
items.org: SDT (Savunma Teknolojileri Mühendislik), GKTY / YİİB Team
bullets: Operate a 3-master OKD cluster with KubeVirt running 22 Xubuntu VMs in a dedicated namespace; bastion + HAProxy front-end and dedicated monitoring host.

Built and maintain the observability stack: Prometheus federation, Grafana dashboards (pod, cluster overview, and NOC dashboards), Loki, Alloy DaemonSet, OpenTelemetry Collector with bearer-token auth.

Run the DevOps toolchain end-to-end: GitLab CI/CD with non-root OKD runners (kaniko + privilege SCC, Maven settings via ConfigMap/Secret/PVC mounts), Nexus Docker registry connector, SonarQube CA-trust via init container, ArgoCD with KubeVirt CRD exclusions, TeamCity, YouTrack.
Identity & RBAC: LDAP identity provider on OAuth, AD domain join via SSSD, RBAC/ClusterRoleBindings for ~18 users across 21 namespaces, kubeconfig distribution, group-based xrdp access.

Networking: OVN pod-network IP pinning via annotations, NetworkAttachmentDefinitions for VM bridges, Netplan/nmcli static IPs with src-pinned routes, NetworkPolicy isolation across env-groups, UFW fleet management scripts that pull IPs dynamically from the cluster.
Storage: TopoLVM CSI, CDI StorageProfile fixes, HCO DataVolume troubleshooting, IBM FlashSystem-backed volumes.
Resolved a 22-day YouTrack/Hub auth outage: traced to JVM heap exhaustion, set jvmoptions to 4 GB, switched to a Recreate deployment strategy, restored base-url consistency.
Onboarding automation for new users (kubeconfig + RBAC + xrdp + Nexus pull secrets + CA trust distribution).

items.title: Cyber Defence Center Analyst
bullets: Monitored real-time alerts in IBM QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel, ArcSight, and CrowdStrike Falcon; triaged suspicious activity end-to-end.
Investigated endpoint threats and supported incident response with Vectra EDR and Microsoft Defender.
Authored incident analysis reports translating technical findings into actionable intelligence for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Prioritized alerts, logs, and security events by impact; identified root causes and contributed to faster response cycles.
Proposed and contributed to SOC process improvements that strengthened detection coverage.

items.title: Research Intern, React.js Web Developer
bullets: Built and maintained front-end components for an AI-powered event photography platform in React.js.
Iterated on usability and performance through repeated build–measure–learn cycles.
